map.输入矩形截面宽度 b 与高度 h，按 W=b·h²/6 计算抗弯截面模量，用于梁: Enter the width b and height h of a rectangular section and the tool computes the elastic section modulus as W = b·h²/6, for a quick check of the bending normal stress σ = M/W of a beam under a bending moment M. It is the key parameter for bending resistance.
map.截面模量用于弯曲正应力 σ = M/W。: The section modulus is used in the bending normal stress σ = M/W.
map.矩形梁弯曲最大应力 σ=M/W 计算。: Maximum bending stress of a rectangular beam, σ = M/W.
map.木梁、钢板梁截面设计。: Section design for timber beams and plate girders.
map.高度对截面模量的敏感性分析。: Sensitivity analysis of the section modulus to the height.
map.σ_max=M/W，W 越大最大应力越小。: σ_max = M/W; the larger W is, the smaller the maximum stress.
map.绕弱轴弯曲时 W 小，应力大，设计须注意受力方向。: Bending about the weak axis means a small W and a large stress, so the load direction matters in design.
map.→ 打开截面模量（W = b·h² / 6）工具: → Open the Section Modulus (W = b·h² / 6) Tool
